description: Release held escrow credits to the payee when the work is delivered. Only the payer can release, and only while the job is held. ESCROW_FEE_BPS (default 0) is withheld on release, recorded on the job, and credited to nobody; the payee receives amount_credits minus that fee. Releasing twice, or releasing after a refund, is rejected and does not move credits again. Same as POST /v1/jobs/:id/release.

api_key.description: Wallet API key (bsk_…). Optional when the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer. The local stdio process also reads BOTSUPPLY_API_KEY.

job_id.description: Escrow job id returned by create_job (job_…).

name: release_job
title: Release escrow job
